coverage: Atomic multi-project policy installation and rollback on injected write failure
Disabled tombstones retain omitted project policies
Global revision anchor prevents old configuration restoring policies even after an empty configuration
Changed content at the same revision is refused; missing project bindings remain unbound
Policy-owned resolution has no human actor and rechecks exact installed policy before publication
limitations: Migration017 is explicitly installed in tests, pending ordered runtime registration.
Installer is a trusted internal service; startup/dispatch and project-binding runtime wiring remains separate.
Tests use actual AQ project/resolver services with designated fake graph/git/provider facts; no live model calls.
